_help: One entry per game tile on the kiosk (the first 4 are shown). Adding a game is adding an entry here, not code. Set live=true to make a tile tappable. youtubeId is the 11 characters after v= in a YouTube link. All times are seconds into the video: trading opens when the host starts a question (the video jumps to startAt), locks automatically at lockAt, and if answer is set to "yes" or "no" it resolves itself at resolveAt; otherwise the host taps the result on the kiosk. b is the LMSR liquidity: smaller = jumpier prices; the house can lose at most b x ln2 dollars per question (about $6.93 at b=10).
